resources.string: Configure one target, watch the dump/export state, then repair from the exported files.
Pick an app to prepare dump, status, and repair paths.
Target process. Empty = main/any process, * = all processes, or com.example.app:remote
Output root, e.g. /sdcard/Download/R0DUMP. Empty = target app private directory
Class name prefix filter. Empty = all, e.g. com.example.
Maximum active dump method count. 0 = unlimited
Maximum method records before auto stop, e.g. 50000
Maximum active seconds before auto stop, e.g. 300
Dex write mode: skip, overwrite, or hash_check. Default = skip
Class walk mode: load_all or loaded_only (load_all keeps current coverage)
Process mode: main_only, exact, or all
Stop native runtime after class walk completes (may miss later dynamic dex)
Global runtime dump: enable R0DUMP for all apps (target package is treated as *)
Lab: force backfill via guarded method invoke (high risk, manual)
Enable force backfill calls during class walk
Force backfill class prefix, empty = class filter
Warning: FORCE_BACKFILL invokes target methods. Keep limits low and test manually.
Blocked unsafe config: force backfill requires a class prefix or force backfill class prefix to avoid app-wide active invocation crashes.
Strategy: class walk + reflective Method/Constructor active dump
Trigger: configure runtime before Application attach/create
Trigger: start dump after Activity creation
Lab: dump during real method invocation / interpreter execution (higher overhead)
Lab: dump when ClassLinker LoadMethod materializes a method (earlier trigger, higher overhead)
Lab: dump dex when DexFile is loaded (useful for dynamic dex loading)
Lab: dump dex when RegisterDexFile registers it (performance-sensitive)
Lab: InMemoryDexClassLoader / ByteBuffer dex dump (recommended for in-memory loaders)
Lab: export raw/fixed dex at ClassLinker::DefineClass; method records come from delayed class-walk (performance-sensitive, opt-in)
Lab: dump class methods after LoadClass (performance-sensitive)
Lab: dump when ResolveMethod resolves a method (high-frequency / high-overhead)
Lab: DexFileLoader OpenCommon dump (central dex open point)
Lab: dump methods after class verification
Lab: dump after class initialization succeeds
Lab: dump on interpreter Execute (very hot)
Lab: dump on JIT MethodEntered sampling path
Lab: dump on instrumentation method enter
Lab: dump on instrumentation method exit
Note: dex open points may dump early but can duplicate REGISTER_DEX/DEX_LOAD output.
Warning: execution/instrumentation points are hot paths; enable one at a time.
Lab: app image AddImageSpaces dex dump
Note: Java route points emit logcat audit records; use them for timeline reconstruction.
The default profile prioritizes a usable target startup: wait for Activity, walk classes, extract methods and constructors, then stop. DEFINE_CLASS is an advanced opt-in strategy.

Recommended device test order: IN_MEMORY_DEX → DEFINE_CLASS → REGISTER_DEX → LOAD_CLASS → RESOLVE_METHOD.\nEnable DEFINE_CLASS manually only when class-definition capture is needed; it adds ART work during startup. Test one performance-sensitive or route-audit point at a time.

Default output is product-managed: R0DUMP writes hot-path files to the target app external-private working directory, then exports one snapshot to Download/R0DUMP when class-walk completes or limits stop runtime.
Everything below is experimental. Enable one point or one group at a time after the default profile is confirmed on the target app.

Status is read from exported _r0dump_status.json or r0dump_status.json when available. If no exported status exists yet, wait for class-walk completion, a limit stop, or inspect logcat with tag [R0DUMP].
Working directory: target app private external files/r0dump/<process>.\nPublic export: /sdcard/Download/R0DUMP/<process>.\nManager repair should use the public export path after dump finishes.

Repair follows the selected app. Scan the app export directory, then R0DUMP reads methods_*.jsonl from that directory, patches matching dex files, removes duplicate outputs, and writes a repaired zip.
Export current bin directory to Download/R0DUMP

Dynamic dex preset applied: InMemoryDex, Dex load, DefineClass fixed dex, and raw dexdata mirror. Test one target first.
